verdict.rationale: Supabase ships Supabase Cron, a first-party Postgres module for scheduling recurring jobs with cron syntax and monitoring their runs. This is a true recurring schedule, not a one-off action. The agent-skills catalog also includes Cron, so AI agents can use it, and Queues offers durable message handling that could support workflows. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled jobs run reliably, documented multi-step workflow orchestration beyond individual cron jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Supabase Cron is a Postgres Module that simplifies scheduling recurring Jobs with cron syntax and monitoring Job runs inside Postgres.
covering Database, Auth, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storage, Vectors, Cron, and Queues
